subject: Discovery recap: multi-tenancy controls & tiering (Redwood + Acme)
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Joe Alvarez <joe@acme-corp.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 10 Feb 2026 15:20:00 -0800
Subject: Discovery recap: multi-tenancy controls & tiering (Redwood + Acme)

Hi Joe —

Thanks again for taking the time today. Quick recap from our call so we have a shared understanding and clear next steps.

High-level pain points you shared:
- Need per-customer rate limits and quotas to avoid noisy tenants impacting other customers
- Requirement for per-tenant routing/policy controls (tiering, regional routing) to support enterprise SLAs
- Want predictable cost allocation per customer (per-tenant metrics + billing tags)

Current stack and constraints:
- Hosting inference on a mix of managed endpoints + internal GPU clusters
- Using an in-house API gateway for routing today; limited visibility into per-customer token usage
- Security/compliance: on-prem connectivity for regulated customers, SOC 2 is a must

Success criteria you defined:
1) Ability to enforce per-tenant rate limits and quotas (burst + sustained)
2) Route traffic by tenant to different model variants / regions based on tiering rules
3) Token-level cost attribution and exportable usage reports (daily/weekly)
4) Support for private deployment and KMS integrations for highest tier customers

What we propose (next steps):
- I shared a short one-page summary (attached) that maps Redwood features to your success criteria.
- Ben will set up a focused demo on tenant routing, quota configs, and billing tags — target next week.
- We'll provide a sample config and a short runbook for integrating your gateway with Redwood routing APIs.
- You asked for SOC 2 evidence; attaching our SOC2_summary and we can connect Security if you want deeper review.

Attachments: redwood-multi-tenant-summary.pdf (summary of features), SOC2_summary.pdf

Action items:
- Ben (cc) to propose 2 demo slots for next week — owner: ben.carter@redwood.com
- Marissa to share proposed pricing bands for tiering model — owner: marissa.cole@redwood.com (I will attach a starter sheet)
- Joe to confirm additional internal stakeholders (security, platform) to include in the demo

Thanks — looking forward to progressing.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com | (415) 555-0123

-----
Attachment: redwood-multi-tenant-summary.pdf (1 page summary)

Marissa —

Thanks for the clear recap. This aligns with what we discussed. A couple quick clarifications: 
- For rate limits, do you support both global tenant limits and per-route limits (we have some customers who hit specific endpoints harder)?
- For billing tags, can we export per-tenant token usage daily to our billing pipeline (CSV or S3)?

I'll loop in Sara from our Platform team (sara@saasops.io) — she needs to attend the demo. Also adding our security lead (cc in the next thread) if SOC2 evidence looks good.

If Ben can propose some times for next week that works.

Joe

joe@acme-corp.com

Joe —

Short answers: yes to both. Quick details we will demo:
- Rate limits: support for tenant-level and route-level limits, configurable burst windows, and token-based throttling.
- Billing export: daily per-tenant usage export to S3 + CSV/JSON, plus tagging support for downstream billing systems.

Proposed demo slots (Pacific times):
- Tue 17 Feb 10:00—10:45
- Wed 18 Feb 14:00—14:45

If one of those works I'll lock it and send a calendar invite. Agenda will focus on routing rules, quota configs, and the billing export pipeline; we'll include a short Q&A for Security.
